description: This file contains test scripts for Git checkout behaviors, specifically concerning operations from unborn branches, preservation of untracked files and index contents, handling of orphan branches, and checkout in a new repository.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a descriptive label.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares file contents to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository based on provided parameters.
